snippet.title: Light Devourer | Official Teaser Trailer | 2026
snippet.description:
The Steam store page for this game is now live, and we warmly welcome all players to wishlist it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018190

"Light Devourer," developed by SupernaturalHippo Studio, is a pixel-art, top-down action RPG featuring exhilarating combat, highly explorative map design, and a dark fantasy storyline.

The game is set to officially launch on Steam in 2026.
